blocks.text:
After travelling into the Central Andes, you will reach Quilotoa crater lake. It formed after an ancient volcanic eruption. The lake has an average depth of around 250 m and is known for its bright turquoise water.

The trail follows the crater rim and takes about 4-5 hours. This is a long high-altitude walk with changing views of the lake and crater walls. The turquoise water lies far below, and the path stays on the edge of the caldera, so the lake remains in view for most of the route.

After the hike, travel south to Chimborazo Province.

**Accommodation:** Chimborazo Lodge.  
**Meals:** breakfast, packed lunch, dinner.
Chimborazo and the Papallacta hot springs

After breakfast, set out on a hike around the base and surrounding slopes of Chimborazo Volcano. The route crosses high-altitude wetlands. You may see alpacas and vicuñas along the way.

The hike heads for a mountain refuge at around 5,000 m. Afterwards, transfer to the Papallacta hot springs, a drive of approximately 4 hours.

Safety and the group’s wellbeing come first on this part of the itinerary. The guide may change the route if the weather or mountain conditions are unsafe or if participants are unable to continue on the planned route.

Papallacta lies at around 3,220 m and is considered a gateway to Ecuador’s Amazon region. The old Cinnamon Tree Route passed through this area and is associated with Francisco de Orellana’s 1542 expedition. The expedition crossed the Andes in search of gold and other valuables, eventually reaching the Amazon River.

The climate is cool and humid, with average air temperatures of around 10-14 °C, depending on the season. The Termas de Papallacta complex sits beside a river. It has 9 hot thermal pools and 3 cold-water pools. Water temperatures are approximately 30-70 °C at the springs and around 36-40 °C in the pools.

The water contains sulphates, sodium, calcium and magnesium chloride. It is colourless, has no pronounced smell and tastes slightly salty. The pools sit beside the river in a high Andean valley, where you can relax in the cool, humid air. After several days of hiking, you have free time here to recover before the next active day.

**Accommodation:** Termas de Papallacta 4*.  
**Meals:** breakfast, packed lunch.
Vicuñas on a dry high-altitude plateau near snow-covered Chimborazo, Ecuador
